selection_rule: After the ORG-006 law closed, select the positive one-carbon successor of the development butane carrier, CAS 109-66-0, and its first complete NIST CCCBDB experimental internal-rotation surface. Separately select OSTI record 22415852 and its registered public full-text endpoint because its identity and qualitative abstract explicitly concern model-free temperature-dependent conformer probabilities. Exact torsion, energy, temperature and probability values, tables, figures, files, availability outcomes and payload hashes remain unopened.
development_information_disclosed: The OSTI title, DOI and qualitative abstract were development-observed during source identification; therefore only its exact quantitative vector, tables, figures and attachment outcome are claimed value-blind. The NIST pentane page identity was constructed from the fixed CAS successor and endpoint schema without opening its returned content.
